title: _artifact
description: An output of a task, such as a document, source code or a pull request. It either embeds the output or refers to it where it is stored. Draft v0.

version.description: Separate counter per task (scoped by task id). Human-readable form is `task-<task id>-artifact-<version>`, e.g. `task-1-artifact-1`, `task-1-artifact-2`.

ref.description: Where the output is stored: a path, a URL or another reference.
